title: TFL 6 LidarBC public fixture
subtitle: Seven clipped VRI blocks, one road job, and one landing in a ~100 ha pilot AOI
transformation: EPSG:3005 to EPSG:4326 for static browser display; coordinates rounded to six decimals. Geometry is not simplified.
source_data: Only the LiDAR-derived values and clipped VRI geometry are source data. Machine rates, work volumes, productivity, landing capacity, and the road job are synthetic planning values for a smoke test.
not_claimed: No calibrated cost or production rate is claimed.
No operational harvest plan is claimed.
The fixture is not a complete inventory of the pilot AOI.
